name: Újtelek (Hungary)
description: Blue field with a red diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly and a green triangle in the lower fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Újtelek: a crowned blue shield with a white church and the years 1586 and 1991.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
